title: Define the shared multi-table event-reference contract
working_tree_status: dirty shared worktree; bounded DB-009 resolver and contract-test changes present
goal: Define, own, and verify one fail-closed identity and access contract for resolving artist_events, events, and events_v2 references without weakening any consumer authorization boundary

in: The exact direct-importer inventory across event subresources, app/api/payment/route.ts, and lib/events/event-task-workflow.ts
UUID-versus-slug lookup order, source-table identity, owner/org/venue/schedule projection, and published-like viewer access semantics
Focused contract and negative-authorization tests for the shared resolver
out: Schema migrations, hosted database mutation, or destructive events/events_v2/artist_events cutover
Broad consumer behavior rewrites outside the shared resolver contract
Public discovery ranking, ticket purchase behavior, workforce workflows, social posting, or artist event lifecycle implementation
DB-006's six already-bounded canonical events_v2 callers and its required staging/production evidence

acceptance_criteria: The resolver contract explicitly defines identifier forms, lookup order, returned source identity, and field/nullability semantics for artist_events, events, and events_v2

Viewer access is fail closed and tested for anonymous, unrelated authenticated, owner, organization-scoped, published/public, unpublished, missing, and ambiguous references without relying on service-role bypass
Every direct importer is classified by domain and its expected source-table and authorization behavior; incompatible consumers receive named handoffs instead of silent fallback
The contract preserves CP-053 and DB-006 events_v2 canonical direction while keeping explicitly approved legacy compatibility isolated and observable
Focused tests, lint, scoped type diagnostics, importer inventory, diff validation, and control-plane validation pass

progress.summary: All DB-009 local implementation and consumer-inventory acceptance criteria are met and focused verification passes. completed: Assigned the shared multi-table event-reference path to the database agent through this explicit bounded task.

Recorded explicit consumer handoffs for the unbound payment booking/event identity, vendor item-route source divergence, social read-policy evidence, public events_v2 RLS, and unqualified polymorphic event_id consumers.
